audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors, one missing interaction. (a) 'Her E (Vault) dashes in, knocks you back' — Vault does not knock Galio back. (b) 'Q-blind' / 'her Q-blind eats your empowered Smash' — Blinding Assault is a nearsight, not a blind, and does not make Galio miss. (c) Behind Enemy Lines being breakable by Galio's CC was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot on Vault: 'Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.' She displaces herself, not you, and the real effect on Galio is a slow plus a brief interrupt. Riot on Blinding Assault: 'calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision' — vision hinder, no miss chance, so Colossal Smash still lands. Behind Enemy Lines carries the channel flag, and _missing-interactions lists it as cancellable by Shield of Durand and Hero's Entrance.
audit.corrected: Vault slows and briefly interrupts you, then drops her a full attack range behind. Blinding Assault nearsights (you cannot see her; your autos still land). Behind Enemy Lines is a channel — a taunt or an R landing ends it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown section named Vault as matchup-defining without a number, and called Galio's E a stun.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s; Justice Punch knocks up, it does not stun. Heightened Senses is 50s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in her kit and the real punish window for her escape speed.

edits.before: Quinn owns levels 1-3 and you have to accept it. Her Q (Blinding Assault) nearsights you, collapsing your vision and blanking your Colossal Smash empowered auto, while her Harrier passive marks you for heavy bonus auto damage on every trade. Her E (Vault) dashes in, knocks you back, and slows, and after a Harrier proc her W (Heightened Senses) hands her the attack and move speed to walk out of any E-Justice Punch you throw; your dash has a fixed distance and a windup she just sidesteps, and her own Vault can even interrupt your E mid-flight. Don't walk into the wave to last-hit when her Q is up; tag minions with the edge of your Q-Winds of War tornado from max range instead. The one trap to bait: if she Vaults onto you at level 3, eat the knockback and instantly W-Shield of Durand release for the taunt, then E-knockup, but most good Quinns Vault out the second the channel starts.
edits.after: Quinn owns levels 1-3 and you have to accept it. Her Q (Blinding Assault) nearsights you — it hides her, it does not make you miss, so your Colossal Smash auto still lands on whatever you can see — while her Harrier passive marks you for heavy bonus auto damage on every trade. Her E (Vault) does not knock you back: she dashes in, slows you, briefly interrupts you, then leaps off and lands a full attack range away, and after a Harrier proc her W (Heightened Senses) gives her the attack and move speed to walk out of any Justice Punch you throw. Don't walk into the wave to last-hit when her Q is up; tag minions with the edge of your Winds of War tornado from 825 range instead. The one trap to bait: if she Vaults onto you at level 3 her 12-second E is now down, and that is your window to W-taunt into E-knockup, but most good Quinns Vault out the second the charge starts.

edits.before: Level 6 is your only real swing, and it's not in this lane, it's on the map. Hero's Entrance lets you flag a fight bot or mid and drop a taunt-knockup onto two enemies while she's still rotating on foot; her Behind Enemy Lines is map-wide move speed, a roam tool, not a teamfight drop, so your global out-impacts hers in a fight. In lane she still kites you: your W damage reduction is heavily amplified against magic, and Quinn is full physical, so Shield of Durand barely blunts her Harrier autos and Vault. Don't chase her under tower; she Vaults the dive and her Q-blind eats your empowered Smash. Farm what you safely can and look to roam with R the second it's up.
edits.after: Level 6 is your only real swing, and it's not in this lane, it's on the map. Hero's Entrance lets you flag a fight bot or mid and drop a taunt-knockup onto two enemies while she's still rotating on foot. Better still: Behind Enemy Lines is a channel, so a taunt or your R knockup dumps her out of it — she can never ride it into your team. In lane she still kites you: your W damage reduction is heavily amplified against magic, and Quinn is fully physical, so Shield of Durand barely blunts her Harrier autos and Vault. Don't chase her under tower; she Vaults the dive and her nearsight leaves you guessing where she landed. Farm what you safely can and roam with R the second it's up.

edits.before: This stays bad and gets worse in lane. Quinn's lethality build pokes you out of XP range with Harrier-marked autos and Q-blind windows, and your tankiness plateaus while her kite-and-poke pattern never gives your magic-amplified W anything to absorb; there's no AP commitment to sponge here, just physical chip you can't answer. Your value is entirely Hero's Entrance and teamfight engage: stick with your team, flag the global onto her or a backline carry, and let your W-taunt lock someone for your team to kill. Never try to 1v1 her in a sidelane; she Vaults away and you accomplish nothing.
edits.after: This stays bad and gets worse in lane. Quinn's lethality build pokes you out of XP range with Harrier-marked autos and nearsight windows, and your tankiness plateaus while her kite-and-poke pattern never gives your magic-amplified W anything to absorb; there's no AP commitment to sponge here, just physical chip you can't answer. Your value is entirely Hero's Entrance and teamfight engage: stick with your team, and the moment she opens Behind Enemy Lines the channel dies to your taunt or an R landing. Never try to 1v1 her in a sidelane; she Vaults away and you accomplish nothing.

notes: The packet flagged 'Use Hero's Entrance' and 'Her Heightened Senses' as suspect names — both are correct Riot names; false positives. Real name-level errors here were behavioural, not nominal: 'Q-blind' for a nearsight and a knockback that does not exist on Vault. Riot's Vault text says it 'briefly interrupt[s]' the target on landing; I stated that plainly but did NOT assert that it specifically cancels a Shield of Durand charge, because Riot's text does not say so and the kit's needsResearch is empty (unknown, not no). Same reason I did not claim Quinn's Q affects Galio's auto-attack accuracy. Galio's Justice Punch carries a bogus derived 'terrain' flag in the kit library (Riot's description has no terrain) — no terrain claim written.
